items.title: Approve the Minutes of the April 22, 2025 Meeting
Reappoint Sean Kim as the District 1 Representative to the Community Advisory Committee

Allocate $861,500 in Prop L Funds, with Conditions, for Two Requests and Amend the Prop K Standard Grant Agreement for the Ortega Street Improvements Project and Release $280,000 in Funds Held in Reserve for the Project
Amend the Adopted Fiscal Year 2024/25 Budget to Decrease Revenues by $3,517,851 and Decrease Expenditures by $8,877,808 for a Total Net Increase in Fund Balance of $5,359,957
Preliminary Fiscal Year 2025/26 Budget and Work Program
